description: A tight bedroom vignette focused on one side of a bed and its accompanying nightstand area. The headboard wall is clad in vertical-grain light oak or ash veneer paneling with a soft gray undertone, the wood running floor to ceiling in wide flat panels. The wall above the panel line transitions to smooth cool-gray painted plaster. A warm, focused pool of amber light from a small directed source washes a tight cone onto the panel wall just beside the headboard, casting a concentrated warm circle and trailing off quickly into the ambient gray. The bed itself is dressed in crisp bright-white cotton linens — stacked Euro and standard pillowcases with loose, unstructured folds — and a chunky-knit olive green throw blanket is casually folded across the lower-left corner of the bed. Beside the bed sits a low floating or freestanding nightstand in the same light ash wood as the wall paneling, with a single drawer and clean slab-front hardware. On the nightstand surface rests a small white ceramic bowl and a loose chain of gold beads. Two matte-black duplex electrical outlets are mounted flush to the wood panel wall. The camera is positioned at seated to low-standing eye-level, approximately 3.5–4.5 feet high, with a normal to slightly telephoto lens creating a compressed, intimate vignette. The composition is a close off-center thirds shot, favoring the right-center of the frame where the nightstand and panel wall meet, with the bed pillows anchoring the left edge.
